podcast.title: Brian Eno's Influence on Black Star
podcast.body: Ambient music, particularly that associated with Brian Eno, served as a complex influence on David Bowie's Black Star, contributing to the album's unique sonic landscape. "de la música ambiental de Brian Eno."

podcast.title: Designed for Flexible Attention
podcast.body: Coined by Brian Eno, "música ambiental" (ambient music) is characterized by its ability to adapt to multiple levels of auditory attention. It is designed to be simultaneously ignorable and interesting, providing a sonic backdrop that does not impose itself on the listener but rather allows for varied engagement depending on their focus. "La música ambiental debe poder adaptarse a muchos niveles de atención auditiva, sin imponer o en particular. Debe ser tan ignorable como interesante."
